programs.title: Observing the Pack: Agent-Managed Workplaces and Worker Voice
outcomes: Explain how an agent-managed, human-governed DAO like Lyka DAO separates agent operations from human-reserved decisions
Draft a worker-centered proposal for the Proposal Forum that keeps final votes in human hands
Evaluate task-routing systems against collective-bargaining principles

sessions.activity: Tour the DAO charter, mission and reserved-for-humans decision list; map which workplace decisions should stay human-reserved.
Simulate a Task Router working-group cycle: assign tasks, then compare with steward-led delegation models used in unions.
Small groups draft a sample proposal with the Proposal & Grant Drafter workflow; peers debate, then hold a mock human final vote.
Review measurable-outcome dashboards and discuss how progress metrics could be bargained into union agreements.

programs.data_shared: Anonymized mock-proposal drafts and session exit polls about which decisions workers want kept human-reserved, aggregated with no names or worksites.
programs.consent: Adult learners sign a plain-language consent form at signup; participation is voluntary, data is aggregated and anonymized, and anyone can opt out of sharing at any time without penalty.

programs.title: Wolf Watch Data Detectives: Learning from the Lyka Pack
outcomes: Describe how the International Wolf Center in Ely, Minnesota observes real wolf packs on the edge of the Boundary Waters temperate forest
Collect and summarize behavioral observations like the Evidence Monitor agent does
Distinguish agent work from human decisions in a DAO

sessions.activity: Learn how the Evidence Monitor summarizes information; students practice summarizing a short wolf-behavior article into three evidence points.
Explore the DAO charter and the reserved-for-humans list; students sort sample decisions into 'agent can do' vs 'only people vote.'
Teams draft a classroom proposal to help wolf conservation; agents help draft, but the class casts the final human vote.
Students chart their proposal's progress on a simple tracker and present findings to the class.

programs.data_shared: Anonymized class tallies of sorting exercises and proposal-vote outcomes, contributed as aggregate counts only, with no student names or identifiers.
programs.consent: Guardian/parent signed consent is required before participation; teachers explain data sharing in age-appropriate language, only aggregate classroom data is shared, and parents or guardians may withdraw consent at any time.

programs.title: Evidence to Action: Running NGO Programs Through a Human-Governed DAO
outcomes: Apply agent-based monitoring and synthesis to an NGO issue workflow
Structure proposals so agents draft and humans decide
Design measurable outcomes tracked in the Progress Observatory

sessions.activity: Watch how Evidence Monitor and Research Synthesis Agent summarize evidence; staff practice building a two-page evidence brief on a chosen issue.
Use Collaborator Scout and Task Router patterns to map partners and route a working group between decision cycles.
Draft a grant proposal via the Proposal & Grant Drafter workflow; staff debate it and a human panel enacts the mock decision.
Define 3 measurable outcomes and build a simple tracking dashboard aligned to the charter.

programs.data_shared: Anonymized evidence-brief templates and outcome-metric definitions, shared as reusable models with organizational identifiers removed.
programs.consent: NGO staff consent via a data-sharing agreement; contributions are stripped of organization names and beneficiary data, and any partner data is only shared with explicit permission.

programs.title: Packs and Stewards: Nonprofit Governance in an Agent-Managed World
outcomes: Explain stewardship in a model where agents operate and people govern
Map nonprofit board duties onto the DAO's human-reserved actions
Draft charter-aligned measurable outcomes for a mission like AI as a public good

sessions.activity: Study the mission of governing advanced AI as a public good; compare nonprofit bylaws with the DAO charter and reserved decision list.
Role-play a decision cycle: agents present drafted proposals, stewards debate, and only humans cast the final vote.
Work with the Progress Tracker to set measurable outcomes and review dashboards for board oversight.
Leaders review a Research Synthesis Agent briefing and practice asking governance-level questions of agent outputs.

programs.data_shared: Anonymized governance exercise results and sample outcome frameworks, shared as aggregated patterns with no board, donor, or beneficiary identifying details.
programs.consent: Leaders sign a confidentiality and consent notice; all shared material is anonymized and aggregated, donor and beneficiary data is never included, and withdrawal of consent removes prior aggregate contributions where feasible.
